decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no customer reply to welcome email [email:9d53f8ee] or week-one check-in [email:3a70b6ec] despite a held welcome call [calendar:577b043a]. Total customer silence plus no setup progress suggests low unaided odds in the remaining 8 days, though the Team plan signals real intent.

draft.subject: Getting Cedar Ventures' first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Following up on my note last week — no reply needed, I know first weeks get busy. Since the welcome call, I wanted to make sure the setup side isn't blocking you. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you and answer anything about structuring work for your team.

Best,
Priya
